notes: All three PEPlife2 values verified against the Results text: T20 1.22 h, T1144 7.48 h, FLT 27.09 h (the body rounds the last to 27.10). The body reports no dose, no strain, no sex and no group size for the rat PK study, so those fields are 'not reported'. The three agents differ enormously in size - T20 and T1144 are 36-37mers while FLT is a ~22 kDa monobody fusion of 163 residues - and the 22-fold half-life span tracks that, consistent with the albumin-binding-domain mechanism the paper describes. For context the paper notes T20's human half-life is 3.46-4.35 h and T1144's is 12-15 h, both substantially longer than the rat values here.
